observations.detail: Video opens with Peter Parker abandoning his costume, captions sync well with single-word pop style.
Narration flows smoothly as Peter struggles with university grades and personal stress.
Daily Bugle editorials and Jameson framing panels are shown clearly with good pacing.
Suit discarded in trash can scene matches the narration accurately.
Underworld crime syndicates erupting without Spider-Man shown effectively in the panels.
Final retrieval of the mask to reclaim the city wraps up the narrative cohesively.
